<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_BuildingAHouse" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/building-a-house">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BuildingAHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Stores" name="Online stores"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialRequirements" name="Initial requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AdditionalRequirements" name="Additional requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_UpdatedDraft" name="Updated draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdatedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MaterialOrders" name="Material orders" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Stores"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProcessedOrders" name="Processed orders" sourceRef="Participant_Stores" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProcessedOrders"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuildRequest" name="Request to build the house" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartyInvitations" name="Tree house party invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a House" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_You">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BuildingHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RefineDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefinementDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAdditionalRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveUpdatedDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveProcessedOrders</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContactFriends</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BuildingHouse" name="Start building a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to the architect"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementDecision" name="Refine the plan again?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" name="Send additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveUpdatedDraft" name="Receive updated draft"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create materials list from the plan"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Order materials and contact friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials" name="Order materials by category from several online stores"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProcessedOrders" name="Wait for material orders to be processed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Send messages to friends to build the house"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Orders processed and friends contacted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the house with friends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_BuildingHouse" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06_Repeat" name="Refine again" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdatedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveUpdatedDraft" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09_Ready" name="Plan ready" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11_Order" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProcessedOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProcessedOrders" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14_Contact" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="EndEvent_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
